scope: The Regency of Tunis under the French protectorate. Separate from metropolitan France, Algeria and the retained Ottoman economy. Appendix I uses a modeled growth rate before 1906 because early enumerations covered the French population only. Adopt the territorial reconstruction without assigning provincial populations.

British Honduras within colonial boundaries, separate from Honduras, Guatemala and Mexico. Appendix I uses Bulmer-Thomas Tables A.1 and C.1 and compares with Kuczynski vol. III p. 4 and the 1901 colonial census.

Jamaica island. Cayman and Turks and Caicos are separate study series. Appendix I uses Bulmer-Thomas Tables A.1 and C.1. Jamaica did not take the 1901 imperial census, so the opening uses the historical reconstruction.

The independent republic, separate from Argentina and Brazil. Appendix I uses the national estimate from Bulmer-Thomas Table 3.1. Uruguay's statistical office records no general census between 1860 and 1908.
